summary: Section 2.9.8 now specifies the proportional odds check as a diagnostic variant, not a change to ordinal-ar1-stan-v4, with independent N(0, 0.5) priors on the two threshold-specific coefficients, an ordering constraint for every report, and model version ordinal-ar1-ppo-check-v1 to be added before the 6-month analysis. The safety notice updates after reports the app sends and when a page returns to the screen or reconnects, and a fit is published only if it used the study start set at publication. I am satisfied the protocol can be finalized.

Section 2.9.8 now names a diagnostic variant, gives independent N(0, 0.5) priors on the two coefficients, requires ordered cumulative logits for every report (observed and imputed), and names ordinal-ar1-ppo-check-v1 to be added before the 6-month analysis.

minor.problem: A factor that fails the proportional odds check is to be reported with both coefficients next to its confirmatory result. Those coefficients are on the standardized log-odds scale, while the confirmatory result is an odds ratio per natural unit, so the two numbers are not comparable as written.
minor.requested_change: Say that the two threshold-specific effects are reported on the same scale as the confirmatory estimand (odds ratio per natural unit, with 95% intervals), or say that they are log-odds per standard deviation.
